summary: Iteration 12 QA of Notification Center Phase 2 (Alerts module). Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass in ~6s covering role gates, owner-only /alerts/webhook-info, public Zapier webhook (bad-token 401, review happy-path, new_lead pretty-title, invalid-kind→custom fallback, external_id dedupe), and per-principal read-marker isolation (owner reads → owner=0 while marketing still ≥1). Frontend: 4 role personas exercised end-to-end (owner + sales ghost + marketing ghost + crew ghost) — all 26 UI selector checks pass. Owner sees badge + full feed + LeadTimer chip ('Uncontacted 0m') + Zapier card + both email placeholders + FB/IG placeholders; badge clears after visit. Sales sees feed but NO Social tab, only contact@ email card, no Zapier card. Marketing sees Social tab (FB/IG) + only contact@ email, no Zapier. Crew has NO Notifications nav item and direct /notifications redirects to /today.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py alerts module (~L4467-4565): role gate ALERT_ROLES=('owner','sales','marketing') correctly excludes crew (403 verified for all 3 endpoints). Owner-only /alerts/webhook-info uses require_owner dep — sales/marketing/crew all 403 verified.

server.py create_alert (~L4473): dedupe implemented via mongo `$setOnInsert` on _id when dedupe_key is provided. Zapier maps external_id → dedupe_key='zap:<external_id>'. Two identical POSTs → one alert (verified).

server.py zapier_webhook (~L4552): validates payload.token against settings.zapier_webhook.token — missing/wrong token → 401. Invalid kinds not in ALERT_KINDS silently coerced to 'custom' (verified). new_lead title becomes 'New lead: <lead_name>' when lead_name provided (verified).

server.py _read_key (~L4490): uses p.get('user_id') OR 'role:<role>' fallback — this means ghost users (which have user_id) get distinct read markers from real users. Isolation verified: owner marks read → owner unread=0 but marketing unread still ≥1 after the same fresh alert.

Notifications.jsx LeadTimer (~L28-53): color classes match spec — green<5min (bg-emerald-100), orange>=5min (bg-orange-500), red+pulse>=15min (bg-red-600 animate-pulse). Contacted chip renders 'Contacted in Xm' when contacted_at present. testids lead-timer + lead-timer-contacted both wired.
Notifications.jsx (~L119): canSocial=owner||marketing correctly gates the Social tab AND its TabsContent. Sales ghost verified NOT to render notif-tab-social.
Notifications.jsx email tab (~L162-170): contact@ card always rendered; keithrivera@ card is guarded by isOwner — sales+marketing ghosts verified NOT to have email-placeholder-owner in DOM.

Layout.jsx (~L84-100): hasAlerts=['owner','sales','marketing']; alertsUnread polled every 60s; auto mark-read fires on location.pathname.startsWith('/notifications'). Badge testid 'nav-badge-notifications' (from to.replace('/','-') on '/notifications' → '-notifications'). Verified badge shows '1' after a fresh webhook push and disappears after visiting /notifications + reload.
App.js routes for crew do not include /notifications — visiting the URL falls through Navigate('*') → /today. Verified.

public_router.post('/webhooks/zapier'): correctly uses public_router (not api_router) so it is reachable without auth header — only token query param validates. Route path in browser is /api/webhooks/zapier (public_router mounted under /api).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI selector checks across owner + 3 ghost personas pass — see detailed_test_results)

Fixture webhook_url auto-fetches the current secret token from /api/alerts/webhook-info as owner, so it self-heals if the token is ever rotated. rca of the issue: No issues found. All acceptance criteria in the review-request met. Two minor observations (informational, not bugs): (1) The lead-timer chip in the owner UI shows 'Uncontacted 0m' for the current in-preview QA new_lead alert — since 'QA Timer Lead' was inserted by main agent, its created_at may have been set to now() rather than 15+ min ago; if main agent wants to demo the red+pulse styling in a screenshot, they can either use a fake created_at OR just wait 15 minutes. The color logic in LeadTimer is verified correct by code review. (2) Old QA alerts from iterations 10-11 ('QA Timer Lead' + 'Maria' review) plus the ~7 alerts pushed this iteration will show as unread for any principal that hasn't yet visited /notifications — this is by design (per-principal marker) and clears on visit.
